vehicle.notes: Starter selectable profile for the base 10th-gen Civic LX/EX 2.0L/CVT sedan, added from the 2026-09-10 vehicle-selection-expansion research recommendation. Generic de-badged sedan top-down silhouette only — no 3D asset. Populated with a small set of conservative, source-cited community torque values; not tied to a specific owner's car.
vehicle.researchStatus: Starter pass scaffolded from public community/forum and torque-spec-aggregator sources (CivicX.com, Honda-Tech, and multiple independent torque-spec compilation sites that cross-agree on the same figures). All values are tagged community tier, not official/factory; verify against a Honda factory service manual or dealer documentation before use.
researchQuestions: Can you confirm this is the base LX/EX trim with the 2.0L K20C2 engine and CVT, not the 1.5L turbo (Si/Sport/Touring) variant, which has different service specs?
Do the wheels use the stock 12x1.5 lug nuts (standard on most 10th-gen Civic trims), or a different thread size/aftermarket wheel setup?
Is the oil drain plug the stock M14x1.5 bolt, or has it been replaced with an aftermarket/magnetic drain plug?
What brake pad/rotor brand is currently installed, if known — stock or aftermarket?
Do you have access to a Honda factory service manual, dealer printout, or other primary source we could use to verify these community-sourced torque values?
Which additional systems would be most useful to add next: brakes, suspension, spark plugs, or something else?
